threshold_result.statement: For the attempted s_16 no-pivot extension, all sampled-ratio cases r<=3 close as in the manuscript. The only saturated r=4 case forces a four-set H with P_HH strictly diagonally dominant/invertible; because P_HH=A_HT B^{-1} A_SH, both adjacent 4x4 maps are invertible. This saturates rank(P_LL)<=4 rather than contradicting it.
